$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all portfolio threshold numbers. The constitution (Portfolio Research System/00_Investment_Philosophy_and_Portfolio_Operating_Constitution.md) states these rules in prose; this file is the machine-readable twin. Skills must reference this file and must not restate numbers that differ from it. Change a number here and in the matching constitution paragraph — nowhere else.

LEAPS_OPTIONS.note: LEAPS only; short-dated options are outside this cap

position_sizing.let_winners_run_rule: Never mechanically trim a Stage 2 winner with intact fundamentals and rising/stable estimates solely because RSI > 70 or weight crossed 15%; allow appreciated weight up to runaway_winner_cap_pct (22%) while trailing the stop to the rising 21-day EMA or 50-day SMA.

risk_unit_sizing.note: Size new entries by NAV risk-to-stop (bps of portfolio lost if stop is hit) capped by the tier notional range. Wider stops automatically receive smaller initial notional weights.

underwriting_philosophy.principle: Almost any non-fraudulent, solvent business is ownable if the price is cheap enough (high valuation asymmetry / low Reverse-DCF implied growth) and the fundamental + technical trajectory is inflecting upward. Evaluate ALL 3 layers for every company; never skip Layer 2 or Layer 3.

hard_red_lines.description: True binary disqualifiers (solvency, governance, or structural Stage 4 breakdown). Failing a red line routes to AVOID / REJECTED, though Layers 2 and 3 are still documented.
US: Net Debt / EBITDA >= 4.0x with interest coverage < 2.0x (distressed balance sheet)
Stage 4 breakdown (Close < falling SMA50 < falling SMA200) with no base formation (Test C not passing)
Severe governance / accounting fraud / going-concern warning
IN: Debt-to-Equity >= 1.20x (non-financial; excluding standard trade LC acceptances where interest coverage >= 3.0x) or interest coverage < 2.0x

Promoter pledge >= 25% of promoter holding (or >= 20% only when combined with D/E >= 0.70x, falling earnings, or a Stage 4 breakdown; a static 20-25% pledge on a growing, low-debt business is a Layer 2 WATCH, not a Layer 1 hard red line), or a material pledge jump (> 5 percentage points QoQ) into a Stage 4 falling stock

3-Year Cumulative CFO / PAT < 0.25 (or < 0.40 for mature non-order-book businesses) UNLESS the company qualifies under the High-Growth Working-Capital Ramp-Up Exemption: Capital Goods, Defense, Power Transmission/Transformers, Infra, EPC, or Manufacturing businesses with YoY revenue growth >= 35% (or PAT growth >= 50% or 3Y sales CAGR >= 25%) and either unexecuted order book >= 1.5x TTM revenue or positive latest H1/FY operating cash flow are exempt from the trailing 3Y CFO/PAT red line (scored as a Layer 2 working-capital WATCH instead of a Layer 1 disqualifier, because rapid order-book execution consumes working capital upfront). Note: SEBI LODR requires statutory Cash Flow Statements only semi-annually (H1/Sep and FY/Mar); never fail a Q1/Q3 evaluation solely because a quarterly CF statement is unpublished.
Stage 4 breakdown (Close < falling SMA50 < falling SMA200) with no base formation (Test C not passing)

COMPOUNDER.description: High static quality + steady growth + reasonable valuation.
COMPOUNDER.US_standards: ROIC (GAAP, or adjusted ex-M&A intangibles amortization, or ROTCE/ROE for financials) >= 12% (prefers >16%), FCF margin >= 12% (N/A for banks/insurers), Net Debt/EBITDA < 3.0x, SBC < 8% of revenue (or SBC < 15% if Owner FCF margin [FCF margin minus SBC %] >= 10% and diluted share count growth <= 3.0% YoY).
COMPOUNDER.IN_standards: ROCE (or adjusted ROCE ex-goodwill / ROE for financials) >= 15% (prefers >18%), D/E < 0.70, 3Y CFO/PAT >= 0.70 (or >= 0.50 for Capital Goods / Defense / Infra / EPC / Manufacturing businesses growing revenue >= 20% CAGR with D/E < 0.50 and ROCE >= 18%).

TURNAROUND_VALUE_INFLECTION.description: Trailing static metric misses standard compounder floor, BUT price is cheap and rate-of-change (trajectory) is turning up.
TURNAROUND_VALUE_INFLECTION.qualification_rule: Qualifies when: (1) all hard_red_lines pass, (2) at least 2 trajectory signals are positive (QoQ/YoY margin expansion, improving cash conversion/working capital days, rising consensus EPS revisions, or debt reduction), (3) Reverse-DCF implied growth is below realistic 3Y forward growth or valuation is at a >20% discount to 3Y median multiple, and (4) reward-to-risk asymmetry clears 2.5:1 (at CMP or at the planned limit-order Entry Zone).

TACTICAL_BREAKOUT.description: Stage 2 momentum leader or Stage 1 base breakout with earnings/revenue acceleration or major dated catalyst. For high-growth tech/industrial breakouts, SBC < 15% (with positive FCF-less-SBC) is permitted.

underwriting_philosophy.layer2_kpi_rule: Score 3-5 company-specific KPIs as PASS (1.0 pt), WATCH (0.5 pt), or FAIL (0.0 pt). Qualifies (PASS or PASS_WITH_WATCH) when weighted score >= 3.0/5.0 (or >= 2.5/4.0) AND at most 1 KPI is FAIL. For example, 3 PASS + 2 WATCH + 0 FAIL (= 4.0/5.0) or 3 PASS + 1 WATCH + 1 FAIL (= 3.5/5.0) QUALIFIES as PASS_WITH_WATCH; never reject a company with 0 or 1 KPI FAIL if weighted score >= 3.0/5.0. Reject (FAIL) only when >= 2 KPIs are FAIL or weighted score < 3.0/5.0.
underwriting_philosophy.technical_routing_rule: Separate business/valuation qualification from entry timing. Only a Stage 4 breakdown (Close < falling SMA50 < falling SMA200 with Test C failing) is a Layer 1 technical disqualifier (REJECTED). If a candidate passes hard_red_lines, qualifies under an archetype + Layer 2 KPIs, and clears the asymmetry floor at CMP or at its verified support Entry Zone, but is currently (a) in a Stage 3 pullback or Stage 1 base above a rising/flat 200-DMA, or (b) in Stage 2 but extended (> 1.6 ATR above support), DO NOT reject/archive it — set gate_status = PASSED_CONDITIONAL (or PASSED) and route it to WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (or ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP via limit order in the Entry Zone) so it stays on the Shortlist/Watchlist with concrete limit/breakout triggers.

asymmetry_floor.formula: (target_base - entry_ref) / (entry_ref - stop_loss), where entry_ref is CMP for immediate entries or entry_zone_high for limit-order / WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT setups
asymmetry_floor.target_anchoring: Anchor target_base to 12-24M Forward EPS (FY27E/FY28E) x 3Y Median P/E (or justified DCF / EV-EBITDA / P-B for financials / Technical Base Measured-Move). For multi-year CORE_ALPHA compounders, 2-year forward EPS (FY28E) x 3Y median P/E (or current P/E if below 3Y median) is permitted so 3-5 year compounders are not penalized by 1-year multiple compression.
asymmetry_floor.incumbent_holding_rule: The asymmetry_floor (2.0x Core, 2.5x Tactical) governs NEW capital deployment (IMMEDIATE_BUY / ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP) and 3-condition swap comparisons. Never mechanically EXIT an existing holding that is trading above its active invalidation stop solely because a bounce narrowed its R:R to a static prior target_base; evaluate existing holdings against target_bull / forward revisions and trail the stop.

support_distance_ladder.action: starter / limit order only, reduced size
no chase at market — place limit order in entry zone or wait for pullback/consolidation

stop_placement.CORE_ALPHA: below nearest structural invalidation support — min(swing_low_20d, SMA50) minus 1.0 x ATR(14) for Stage 2 uptrends, or base_low_63d minus 1.0 x ATR(14) for Stage 1 / turnaround bases (do NOT mechanically use a distant 200-day MA in a Stage 2 advance; Risk-Unit Sizing already scales position weight to stop distance)
stop_placement.TACTICAL_MOMENTUM: below min(swing_low_20d, SMA20 or SMA50) minus 0.5 x ATR(14)
stop_placement.undercut_and_reclaim_rule: Evaluate stops strictly on the current session's close — never latch a prior session's unexecuted stop breach as a permanent exit order. If a holding closed below its written stop during a prior session (shakeout) and was not sold, and the current session's close has reclaimed the written stop (or closed within 0.25 x ATR(14) of it on a positive reversal day with 1D return > 0% and RSI >= 32), the prior breach is Forgiven as an Undercut-and-Reclaim shakeout. Retain the holding (HOLD / HARD STOP) and reset the active invalidation stop to 0.5 x ATR(14) below the shakeout low (swing_low_20d).

capitulation_reversal_watch.trigger: Benchmark below SMA50 and SMA200 (Downtrend), BUT universe breadth_pct_above_50dma <= 25% (washed-out capitulation territory) AND green shoots appear (benchmark 1D return >= 0%, or bouncing >= 1.0% off 20-day swing low, or VIX cooling on the day).
capitulation_reversal_watch.label: Downtrend (capitulation bounce / follow-through watch)
capitulation_reversal_watch.holdings_rule: Do NOT wholesale-liquidate holdings into cash on a breadth-washout bounce. Retain all Stage 2 leaders, Stage 1/3 holdings above their active stops, and Undercut-and-Reclaim shakeouts (with stops anchored below the panic swing low). Only exit broken Stage 4 laggards that failed Test C or true solvency/governance red-line failures.
capitulation_reversal_watch.deployment_rule: Instead of parking 30-45% in idle cash waiting for the index to clear its 50-DMA, rotate capital freed from Stage 4 laggards into pilot/starter positions (up to 50% of standard Risk-Unit tier weight) or support-zone limit orders in shortlist candidates passing Test A (Stage 2 leader), Test B (base pivot), or Test C (turnaround inflection), using the capitulation swing low minus 0.5 x ATR(14) as the hard stop. Target cash remains near the policy ceiling (10-15%), not 40%+.

momentum_gate.note: Computes Test A (in Stage 2 momentum now), Test B (entering momentum from a flat base), and Test C (turnaround / recovery inflection above a 63d floor) from the frozen price snapshot (scripts/momentum_gate.py). Nearest verified support is the highest structural support (SMA20, SMA50, 20d swing low, or 63d base low) at or below price.

test_b_entering_momentum.conditional_entry: allocated only on a confirmed breakout of the base pivot or a retest that holds; never before

test_c_turnaround_inflection.conditional_entry: turnaround / value inflection setup: floor holding above 63d low with short-term trend or relative strength turning up; starter or limit entry near support with strict stop below swing low
